The Red Year (2)
Antisemitic and Islamic Violence
The vicious antisemitism and anti Americanism mainstreamed by the “Free Palestine” movement certainly was noticed by people with preexisting hatreds along those lines. Whether they were directly motivated by this movement likely varies from one perpetrator to another. But the sequence of murderous attacks by Islamists and secular “Free Palestine” supporters added up over the year.
New Orleans Jihadist Attack
I suspect that many readers have forgotten about this terrorist atrocity that rang in the New Year.
The white pickup truck with an ISIS flag attached to its trailer hitch that
[tore]through Bourbon Street in New Orleans during the first few hours of New Year’s Day of 2025 symbolizes an inflection point for the American people and their leaders. Revelry, music and laughter gave way to terror as fifteen people lost their lives and dozens of others were left with crippling, life-altering injuries from yet another jihadist attack on U.S. soil. The suspected attacker, Samshud-Din Jabbar, a 42-year-old U.S. citizen and former member of the U.S. Army Reserve from Texas, died in a firefight with local police, but given[reports]of ISIS-affiliated terrorists crossing America’s southern border, the threat of more attacks did not die with him.According to the FBI, the Bourbon Street massacre appears to be part of a larger coordinated attack involving accomplices. Hours after yet another example of “vehicular jihad” in New Orleans, a rented Tesla Cybertruck
[exploded]outside the Trump Hotel in Las Vegas, killing one and injuring seven. Both vehicles reportedly were[procured]through the same app, Turo, indicating a common thread of planning and execution. Even if there is no connection between the two attacks, the Bourbon Street attack, by itself, serves as a stark reminder that Islamist terrorism is neither distant nor diminished. It is here, and it is lethal.
The Corporate Media does the minimum possible coverage of these outrages and then drops the story at the earliest possible time. As a result, the American public experiences each attack as an isolated incident that quickly falls into the memory hole. But, read on.
Arson Attack on Governor Josh Shapiro and His Family
The connectivity between “Free Palestine” and this incident of political violence couldn’t be more obvious and direct.
Jewish Insider returns to the story of Cody Balmer’s arson and attempted murder of Pennsylvania Governor Josh Shapiro in its
[Daily Roundup]. JI links to PennLive’s story on the familiar motive that may have driven Balmer’s attack. Based on one of the search warrants executed in the case, Juliette Rihl reports:The suspect in the arson attack at the Governor’s Residence targeted Josh Shapiro due to his perceived stance on Palestine, according to a search warrant obtained by PennLive.
The suspect, Cody Balmer, called 911 following the attack early Sunday, identified himself by name and told operators Shapiro needs to know he “…will not take part in his plans for what he wants to do to the Palestinian people,” the search warrant written by police said.
Balmer continued, saying he needed to “stop having my friends killed” and that “…our people have been put through too much by that monster,” according to the warrant, which says Balmer’s intonation and cadence sounded like he was possibly reading from a script.
Rihl has more on the motive a few paragraphs down in the story:
In the warrant for his devices signed Tuesday, Corporal Benjamin Forsythe of the Pennsylvania State Police says Balmer targeted Shapiro “based upon perceived injustices to the people of Palestine,” as well as Shapiro’s Jewish faith, though the warrant does not elaborate on why Shapiro’s faith is believed to have been a motive.
Recall that Kamala Harris had bypassed this popular Democrat governor of a purple state as her Vice Presidential running mate. I’m sure the fact that Governor Shapiro is Jewish and the Democrats are embracing the “Free Palestine” movement had nothing to do with it.
Israeli Embassy Staffers Assassinated
This brutal assassination of two people employed by the Israeli Embassy in the heart of Washington D.C. is also directly connectable to the “Free Palestine” movement that lives comfortably within the Democrat Party.
Much has been written and tweeted about this recent outrage. But none have achieved the moral clarity and practical guidance as this post titled: “
[Smash the Free Palestine Nazis]” by Benjamin Kerstein. Please read the whole thing, but a few key excerpts follow.In some ways, the horrific murder of Yaron Lischinsky and Sarah Milgrim at a Jewish event in Washington, DC by a Free Palestine Nazi is an exception to the rule. It is explicable in its logic, and its cause can be easily traced.
Its cause is Free Palestine Nazism itself: The first full-scale antisemitic movement in the United States since the 1930s, led by the Red-Green Alliance between radical progressives and Islamic supremacists.
Yes, the Red-Green Alliance is deep and wide. How deep and wide?
Put simply, everyone involved in Free Palestine Nazism, from the foot soldiers to the collaborators, the entire antisemitic movement that took to the streets literally the day after the Oct. 7 massacre to hail the murder of Jews, is guilty.
Politicians are guilty, journalists are guilty, activists are guilty, students are guilty, professors are guilty, academic administrators are guilty, the leaders of international institutions are guilty, beloved NGOs are guilty, all of them are guilty. All of them stand indicted. All of them stand condemned.
I would add to this rogues gallery the
[many Christian pastors and parishioners]who twist the Gospel into a bloody-minded justification for the destruction of Western Civilization in general, and Israel in particular.
You may be asking, “Are we done yet?” Well, no, not by a long shot.
Colorado Murderous Attack on Jewish Demonstrators
In continuance of the “Free Palestine” desire to incinerate Jews, we had the fire bomb attack on a group of Jews and their supporters demonstrating about the October 7 genocide attacks.
… firebombed Jews at a vigil for October 7 hostages in Colorado. This is a terrorist movement motivated by the pro-Hamas Democrats.
Is it shocking to be reminded of just how often political terrorism has been delivered by the “Free Palestine” movement? Is it shocking that the “Free Palestine” movement is an integral part of the Democrat Party? If it is, then please set aside your fantasies and look at the vile world being created by the Democrats.
